DAVID MORGENSTERN

Want to stop spam? Here's how YOU do it
Some of you love SpamNet, a spam-killing app recommended by David Coursey. But others say it blocks too many wanted e-mails, and offer their own tips and tricks for minimizing junk e-mail. David rounds up your suggestions.

DAVID BERLIND

Tablet PCs: Very cool, but not for the masses

While tablet PCs offer cool features, like letting you scribble notes on the screen and swivel the display, David's not sure they're right for everyone. Why? For starters, they're expensive and impractical for traveling.

PRESTON GRALLA

Keep your PC's clock up to the second! Here's how

Your PC, powerful as it may be, is truly pitiful at keeping track of time. But take heart. Preston has three, free downloads that synch your PC's clock with atomic-clock servers, guaranteeing you'll always have the right time.
